message: The other day, I was in the kitchen trying to whip up dinner when I realized that my smoke alarm was a bit too eager—turns out I was just a little too enthusiastic with the sautéing! It got me thinking about how we often rely on gadgets to keep us safe and entertained. So, I decided to go low-tech for a night and organized a little fire safety drill with the kids—no screens, just us practicing our escape plan and chatting about kitchen safety. It was surprisingly fun! Have you ever had a moment where going back to basics turned out to be a blast?
